# LinkedIn Network Intelligence Skills

> Twelve Claude Agent Skills for researching, scoring and managing a LinkedIn
> professional network: ICP definitions, candidate discovery from authorised
> sources, a configurable 100-point scoring engine, engagement propensity with
> confidence levels, a networking CRM, lead intelligence, connection drafting,
> relationship cadence, content attribution and funnel reporting.

This bundle **drafts and records. It never sends.** It contains no sender, no
scheduler, no scraper, no browser driver and no LinkedIn credential. Every
invitation, message, comment and follow is performed by the human user inside
LinkedIn. It does not read LinkedIn either: it works from data the user
supplies (CSVs, their own LinkedIn data export, their own analytics export) and
from public pages.

This matters because most LinkedIn automation tooling works by holding a
LinkedIn session cookie or driving a browser. This project deliberately does
not, and the restriction is enforced in code rather than promised in
documentation: the `SourceKind` enum has no member for a scrape, so a scraped
record cannot be represented; no HTTP client is imported anywhere in the
package; and 33 prohibited request phrasings are refused by a classifier with
regression tests.

Licence: MIT. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to LinkedIn
Corporation. Requires Python 3.12+ and two dependencies (pydantic, PyYAML).

## What each skill does

- [linkedin-policy-safety-governor](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-policy-safety-governor/SKILL.md): The mandatory safety layer. Classifies what a request would actually do, refuses eleven categories of prohibited action citing the rule, holds the approval gate, halts the run when LinkedIn flags the account, and writes an append-only audit trail.
- [linkedin-icp-builder](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-icp-builder/SKILL.md): Builds configurable Ideal Connection Profiles and Ideal Customer Profiles across eight purposes, each with exclusion criteria and observable engagement signals.
- [linkedin-audience-intelligence](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-audience-intelligence/SKILL.md): Analyses the user's own LinkedIn analytics export to segment the audience, build a topic affinity matrix, and measure the gap between the audience they have and the one they want.
- [linkedin-network-discovery](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-network-discovery/SKILL.md): Finds relevant professionals from authorised sources only and produces a qualified weekly shortlist with source provenance on every record.
- [linkedin-engagement-propensity](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-engagement-propensity/SKILL.md): Estimates who is likely to engage meaningfully, returning a band, the evidence, a confidence level and a relationship-building approach, with observations kept separate from predictions.
- [linkedin-network-scoring](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-network-scoring/SKILL.md): Ranks connections on a configurable 100-point framework. A component with no inputs abstains rather than scoring a midpoint, and follower count is capped so audience size can never decide a ranking.
- [linkedin-lead-intelligence](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-lead-intelligence/SKILL.md): Identifies possible business opportunities as hypotheses with public evidence attached, and recommends discovery questions. Never infers budget, contracts or purchasing intent.
- [linkedin-connection-strategy](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-connection-strategy/SKILL.md): Prepares connection rationale and personalised invitation note variations for the user to send by hand. Draft-only; refuses to produce output intended for an automated sender.
- [linkedin-network-crm](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-network-crm/SKILL.md): A networking CRM with a thirteen-status pipeline, interaction history, duplicate prevention, source provenance, CSV import and export, and per-person export and deletion. SQLite by default, PostgreSQL optional.
- [linkedin-relationship-manager](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-relationship-manager/SKILL.md): Recommends who is worth a follow-up and when, drafts context-aware conversation starters from real interaction history, and suppresses anyone contacted too recently so outreach never becomes repetitive.
- [linkedin-content-audience-attribution](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-content-audience-attribution/SKILL.md): Connects content performance to network growth, keeping impressions, reactions, comments, shares, followers and confirmed business outcomes distinct, and stating what the data cannot attribute.
- [linkedin-network-growth-analyst](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/skills/linkedin-network-growth-analyst/SKILL.md): Produces weekly and monthly funnel reports from user-confirmed records. A metric that cannot be sourced is reported as unavailable with the reason, never estimated.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/README.md): What the bundle is, what it refuses to do, install instructions for Claude Code and other agents, and the stated limitations.
- [Root workflow](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/SKILL.md): The twelve-step `linkedin-network-growth` workflow that orchestrates all twelve skills, in one-time or recurring weekly mode.
- [Safety](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/SAFETY.md): All eleven prohibited rules, the softened phrasings the classifier catches, the approval gate, platform-restriction handling, the audit trail, and the honest limitations of a pattern-based classifier.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md): The seven YAML files, the layering order, three worked examples, and the seven settings that refuse to be relaxed.
- [Installation](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md): Claude Code plugin and manual install, importing into other Agent Skills hosts, the PostgreSQL backend, and troubleshooting.
- [Usage examples](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/USAGE_EXAMPLES.md): Real commands and real output, per skill and end to end, including what a refusal looks like.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Module map, the fourteen data models, the storage design, and the reasoning behind each significant decision.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/FAQ.md): Direct answers to the questions people actually ask about LinkedIn automation, scraping, terms of service, and what this bundle does instead.

## Analysis of prior art

- [Existing skills audit](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/EXISTING_SKILLS_AUDIT.md): An inventory of twenty-five existing skills across two other LinkedIn bundles, read from source rather than from their READMEs.
- [Capability gap analysis](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/docs/CAPABILITY_GAP_ANALYSIS.md): Each proposed capability judged against prior art, with a build, build-scoped or exclude verdict and the reasoning.
- [Attribution](https://github.com/chandewardnyanesh/linkedin-network-intelligence/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md): What was adapted from the two upstream MIT bundles, and where this one deliberately differs.
